target: new: continuum between two values (docs/annotation-context-patterns.md, as 'linear-lanceolate'): linear (PATO_0001199) – triangular (PATO_0001875)
reason: A hyphenated shape between linear and deltate (deltate = PATO:0001875 triangular, rule C226). It is handled like the linear-lanceolate continuum, not as a new term.

target: new: conjunction of two values on one bearer: dilated (PATO_0001571) and obtuse (PATO_0001935), bearer plant organ base (FLOPO_0985024)
reason: A lip base that is widened (dilated, as in rule C181 'expanded') into a rounded outline. Both values hold at once, so this is a compound, not a single quality.

target: leaf abaxial stomatal complex (PO_0025190) present + leaf adaxial stomatal complex (PO_0025191) present
reason: Says where stomata are present (amphistomatic). PO has stomatal complexes on each leaf surface, so no quality term is needed.

target: new: continuum between two values (docs/annotation-context-patterns.md) with docs/odp/01-approximate-value.md: orbicular (PATO_0001934) approximately – ovate/ovoid (PATO_0001891)
reason: A hyphenated shape between nearly round and egg-shaped. 'sub-' is the approximately qualifier of pattern 01.

target: new: conjunction of two values on one bearer: trigonous (FLOPO:0991120) and grooved (PATO_0002255)
reason: A blade that is triangular in cross-section and also channelled ('channeled' = PATO:0002255 grooved, rule C196). Two values that both hold.

target: docs/odp/00-part-and-quality.md with negation: bearer apex of leaf lamina tooth (PO_0025518), black (PATO_0000317) negated
reason: A negated colour on the tip of a tooth, as used in keys, not a quality word. The tooth tip exists, so this is not absence of a part. 'Prominent' cannot be represented and is lost.
'Tinged' means faintly coloured. Like 'greenish', it is the colour value with value_qualifier approximately (pattern 01).

target: docs/odp/02-bounded-measurement.md / 05-range-with-extremes.md: length (PATO_0000122) of trichome (PO_0000282) with position abaxial (docs/odp/18-position-of-the-bearer.md)
reason: A measured length of the hairs on one surface. This is a measurement record of a positioned part, not a term.
A widened base of a style, stigma or filament. This is the same reading as rule C181 'expanded' (dilated), with plant organ base (FLOPO_0985024) as bearer.
A rounded leaf base is botanical obtuse, on plant organ base (FLOPO_0985024). 'Narrowly' modifies the degree and cannot be represented.

target: docs/odp/00-part-and-quality.md with the part as bearer: vascular bundle (PO_0005020) part of petal, colour reddish purple (PATO_0104079)
reason: A colour of the petal's veins, not of the petal. The vein is the bearer and the colour is an existing PATO value.

target: comparison or relation stated without its second term
reason: A comparative colour with no part to compare it with, as in rule C242 'darker'.
Sori, indusia and veins lying just inside and parallel to the margin. This is the definition of intramarginal, which already lists PO:0025359 sorus and PO:0005020 among its bearers.

target: new: conjunction of two values on one bearer: increased length (PATO_0000573) and crisped (FLOPO:0991148), bearer trichome (PO_0000282)
reason: Long, curly hairs. Two existing values that both hold for the hairs.
A thin margin. The margin of the part is the bearer and the quality is PATO decreased thickness.
'Forming compact mounds' describes a cushion habit of the whole plant, as in rule C315 'cushion-shaped'. The nectary use is a different sense and should not take this rule.
A red margin. The bearer is the margin of the leaf or leaflet (leaf margin PO_0020128), not the whole leaf.

target: new: conjunction of two values on one bearer: scabrous (FLOPO:0991058) and puberulous (FLOPO:0991049)
reason: Finely hairy and rough to the touch. Both values already exist.
'Semi-' means partly decumbent. This is the value with value_qualifier approximately (pattern 01).
An inflorescence with exactly one flower is a count of parts (1-flowered). It is not FLOPO:0991003 solitary, which is about the inflorescence itself being borne singly.
A margin or protrusion forming an elevated irregular ridge. This matches crested, which already lists FLOPO:0985017 among its bearers. 'Crestlike ridge' on an anther cap is the same reading.

target: new: depth of division (fraction of the blade removed), open in docs/annotation-context-patterns.md
reason: 'Basiscopic side with 1/3-1/2 cut away' gives how much of one side of a pinna is missing. It needs the proposed depth-of-division pattern, not a term.
Dotlike glands and auricles are minute and point-like: PATO punctiform.

target: new: conjunction of two values on one bearer: hirsute (FLOPO:0991050) and glandular-pubescent (FLOPO:0991173)
reason: Hirsute, with glandular hairs among the hairs. Both parts already have FLOPO values, so a new term would only combine them.
'Flagellate' is a synonym of FLOPO:0991247 flagelliform (whip-like), which lists inflorescence among its bearers. This is its negation.
Covered with stiff bristly hairs that feel spiny. This is hispid; 'spiny' only stresses how stiff the hairs are.

target: docs/odp/15-absence-of-a-part.md (needs a bearer class for the equatorial flange of a spore wall)
reason: Absence of a part of the spore (megaspore) wall. PO has no class for the flange, so the rule cannot be written yet.
Teeth and pinna apices (e.g. Polystichum) ending in a bristle-like spinule. Spine-tipped already lists PO:0025518 tooth among its bearers.
Bristles or branches that break easily are brittle.
Calathiform means cup- or bowl-shaped, as in rule C219 'cupuliform'.
